{{Use mdy dates|date=April 2018}} {{Infobox Election | election_name = United States House of Representatives elections in Florida, 2018 | country = Florida | type = legislative | ongoing = yes | previous_election = United States House of Representatives elections in Florida, 2016 | previous_year = 2016 | next_election = United States House of Representatives elections in Florida, 2020 | next_year = 2020 | seats_for_election = All 27 Florida seats to the [[United States House of Representatives]] | election_date = {{Start date|2018|11|06}} | party1 = Republican Party (United States) | last_election1 = 16 | seats1 = | seat_change1 = | popular_vote1 = | percentage1 = | swing1 = | party2 = Democratic Party (United States) | last_election2 = 11 | seats2 = | seat_change2 = | popular_vote2 = | percentage2 = | swing2 = | map_image = | map_caption = }} {{ElectionsFL}} The '''2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida''' will be held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018 to elect the 27 [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representatives]] from the state of [[Florida]], one from each of the state's 27 congressional districts. The elections will coincide with the elections of other federal and state offices, including a [[Florida gubernatorial election, 2018|gubernatorial election]]. The party primaries were held on August 28, 2018.{{cite web |title=Election Dates for 2018 |url=http://dos.myflorida.com/elections/for-voters/election-dates/ |website=Florida Department of State |accessdate=14 June 2018}} {{Horizontal TOC|nonum=yes|limit=2}} ==District 1== {{see also|Florida's 1st congressional district}} The 1st district stretches along the [[Emerald Coast]] and is located in the western [[Florida Panhandle|Panhandle]] anchored by [[Pensacola, FL|Pensacola]], it also includes [[Fort Walton Beach, FL|Fort Walton Beach]], [[Navarre, FL|Navarre]], and [[Wright, FL|Wright]].
